description: Identifiers for the opt-in parts of a SearchQueryResults. Clients pass a list of these values in SearchIndexQuery.responseParts to widen what the server computes and returns. When the list is null or empty the server returns the default minimal payload — HITS plus the always-populated offset — and skips the corresponding work in OpenSearch (no aggregations, no total-hit tracking).
name: SearchQueryPart

enum.name: HITS
enum.description: The matching documents, one SearchHit per row. Returned by default.

enum.name: TOTAL_HITS
enum.description: The total number of matches. May exceed the size of the returned hits list when paginated.

enum.name: SELECT_COLUMNS
enum.description: The list of SelectColumns describing the shape of each hit's fields.

enum.name: FACETS
enum.description: Facet aggregations over the matched documents.
